_meta.purpose: WMXIX-by-move-name survey fragment for CornerStone (ryuji-rock). NEW FILE ONLY - game/assets/movesets/ryuji-rock.json was NOT edited; integration is central.
_meta.hypothesis_verdict: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED - WMXIX carries move names as data (menu.mpq per-wrestler profile specials; Entrance/EMotName.dat code->name table), and its loose animation files are indexed by the EMotName A/B/C/D codes. For entrances those codes are wrestler-keyed, which is how The Rock is identified below. Gameplay grapple/strike animations live in motion/*.mpc YANM packages under a numeric container index; the name->clip mapping for gameplay moves is NOT yet decoded and no gameplay clip is claimed for any named move in this fragment.
